classes.title: Slow and steady
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly
classes.parentTip: Slow playing builds sure fingers. Praise the effort, not the speed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced careful fingers and keeping a steady beat.

classes.title: Play along
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed
classes.parentTip: Keeping up with the music is the goal. Missed notes are fine, just keep going.

classes.title: Concert time
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end and celebrate
classes.parentTip: Clap, cheer and bow together. Mistakes are fine. The fun is playing to someone.
